title: Blogger Scope & Resolution Model Catalog
description: Machine-readable contract defining variable introduction, visibility boundaries, inheritance, and shadowing rules across Blogger XML execution scopes.

lambda.name: Lambda Predicate Scope
lambda.description: Ultra-narrow scope inside lambda pipelines (filter, map, count, etc.). Introduces iterator identifier.
lambda.notes: Iterator member properties MUST be accessed directly without 'data:' prefix (e.g. p.title, NOT data:p.title).

loop.name: Loop Block Scope
loop.description: Iteration block scope inside <b:loop>. Introduces current item variable and optional zero-based index.
loop.notes: Nested loops reusing the same 'var' identifier will shadow outer variables. 'index' counter always increments forward 0..N.

with.name: Scoped Variable Alias Scope
with.description: Block scope inside <b:with>. Aliases an evaluated expression to an identifier to prevent 40-token quota overflow.
with.notes: Used extensively for decomposing expressions and caching expensive collection operations.

includable.name: Subroutine Scope
includable.description: Template subroutine container <b:includable>. Introduces parameter variable passed via <b:include data='...'>.
includable.notes: Standard entrypoint is id='main'. The 'var' attribute names the incoming data parameter (conventionally 'this' or custom name).

widget.name: Host Widget Scope
widget.description: Gadget isolation boundary <b:widget> and default markups <b:defaultmarkup>. Exposes widget-specific dictionary and common data:widget metadata inside <b:includable>.
widget.notes: Direct access to private widget data (e.g. data:posts, data:title) and common metadata data:widget (instanceId, sectionId, type, version) strictly within child nodes of <b:includable> inside <b:widget> or <b:defaultmarkup>. Inaccessible from sibling widgets or outside includables; data:widgets provides layout descriptors and specific summary models per data-widgets catalog, not full private widget dictionaries.

section.name: Layout Section Scope
section.description: Structural layout container <b:section>. Binds section ID and layout visibility conditional.
section.notes: Does not inject custom template variables into child gadgets, but controls section-level conditional rendering via 'cond'.

global.name: Global Template Scope
global.description: Root scope available everywhere across the entire theme XML hierarchy.
global.notes: Universal read-only datasets provided by the Blogger platform runtime. data:widgets provides layout descriptors and specific summary models per data-widgets catalog, not full private widget dictionaries.
